body: Implemented conditional profile renaming and shared-folder registration in the trusted host. Maciek retains all 15 existing projects; Tomek shares the existing cwiczenia source folder. Both profiles read the same Pompki card and counter, unit rep and step 1, with no repetitions added during setup. The 510-test full gate, Chromium/WebKit profile scenarios, counter regressions and broad HTTPS smoke pass. Two verified restarts preserve 28 prior source versions, preferences, identity/epoch and certificate; profile names, shared membership and the counter survive restart. Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-shared-exercise-project.md. Counter values are shared; private access control and physical-device/release acceptance remain outside this result.

metadata.summary: Configured named profiles and the shared exercise project
